Attached: 1 image

Atoms v2 is now available!
This is a major release, a whole rewrite that uses cpak as the engine for creating the environments.

https://github.com/AtomsDevs/Atoms

There are some glitches that I am going to fix directly in libsingulairty, because yes, Atoms v2 dropped libadwaita for libsingularity.

Please report any bug <3
PS. waiting for Flathub approval but it's already available on the cpak' Store: https://cpak.it/store/apps/atoms
